remaining_tasks.progress: Two options identified, neither decided: (a) get_agent_instructions sorts its $or lookup by recency (e.g. most recent _id first) so it always resolves to the current registration; (b) agent registration upserts on hostname instead of always inserting a new document, so duplicates can't accumulate in the first place. (b) fixes the root cause, (a) is a smaller patch. Check what else might depend on multiple agent docs per hostname existing (e.g. historical/audit reasons) before choosing (b).

decisions.rationale: Traced systematically: proved registration/connectivity work, ruled out 3 wrong hypotheses in sequence (agentic_mode_enabled dead code; hostname/id route mismatch not real; silent poll is correct-not-broken behavior), then found the real cause via direct DB query showing 2 agents docs for one hostname.
